item.title: This 10,000 mAh Qi2 battery bank for Pixel 10 is thin without compromise [Gallery]
item.description: Qi2 battery banks are perhaps one of the best accessories for a Pixel 10 owner, but finding one that’s compact while actually having a decent amount of power inside is not easy. But with the new PicoGo AM52 power bank, Baseus has built a 10,000 mAh Qi2 battery bank that just feels right. more…

item.title: Motorola MA2 wireless Android Auto adapter quietly goes official, apparently costs $40
item.description: After leaking in regulatory documents earlier this year, the Motorola MA2 wireless Android Auto adapter has quietly made its debut, with a much lower price point. more…

item.title: Lenovo’s new 8.8-inch Legion Tab is $849 with 9,000 mAh battery, new colors [Gallery]
item.description: Following up on its first release in the States, Lenovo is back with a new Legion Tab, Gen 5, which brings back the compact 8.8-inch form factor but this time with a much bigger battery, new colors, and a way higher price too. more…

item.title: Hands-on: Lenovo’s Legion Go Fold gaming handheld shows a new future for foldables [Gallery]
item.description: Foldables have come a long way in the past few years, but outside of reinventing the flip phone and hiding a tablet within a smartphone, the concepts haven’t changed all that much. Lenovo, though, has a really clever idea in its new Legion Go Fold concept, which I really hope makes it to reality someday. more…

item.title: Lenovo’s latest Android tablets include ‘ThinkTab’ and AI-focused Idea Tab
item.description: Lenovo is coming to MWC with its usual collection of new laptops, concepts, and ThinkPads, as well as throwing a couple of new Android tablets into the mix including the “ThinkTab.” more…

item.title: Hands-on: Lenovo’s modular ThinkBook concept is whatever laptop you want it to be [Gallery]
item.description: There are a lot of different types of laptops out there, but Lenovo wants to give you everything at once with its new ThinkBook modular PC concept, and I kind of love the idea. more…

item.title: Motorola details Razr Fold specs: 6,000 mAh battery, €1,999, still no release date
item.description: Following a preview back at CES, Motorola is officially detailing the Razr Fold specs including a big 6,000 mAh battery and a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset. more…

item.title: Hands-on: Motorola Razr Fold’s software is halfway between Pixel and Samsung [Gallery]
item.description: Motorola’s new Razr Fold looked great when we didn’t know anything about it, but it just looks all the more attractive now. During a hands-on session at MWC 2026 this weekend, I was able to see more of the Razr Fold’s software suite, and it feels very much like it’s the perfect middle ground between the Google Pixel and Samsung Galaxy approaches to book-style foldables. more…

item.title: Motorola confirms GrapheneOS support for a future phone, bringing over features
item.description: Following rumors swirling for quite some time, Motorola has announced a partnership with GrapheneOS that will see the privacy-focused, de-Googled version of Android pre-installed on upcoming Motorola devices. more…

item.title: Qualcomm announces Snapdragon Wear Elite for next gen of Wear OS, Galaxy Watch
